messages:
PagerDuty: Triggered page for service=redwood-inference-api (error-rate spike) region=us-east-az1 severity=high — incident_key=PD-53821. Notifying: alex (sre-oncall)
incident-bot: page fired -> alex, escalation policy: 2m -> priya -> 5m -> eng-sre. PagerDuty link: https://pd.example/PD-53821
alex: ack. i'm on it. pulling quick metrics and health checks now.
incident-bot: alex acknowledged the page (1901234568).
priya: seeing 5xx-rate ~18% from 1901234500 onwards, p95 latency jumped from 220ms -> 1.6s for az1. queue depth for batch workers increasing.
jamie: logs show repeated kvcache eviction warnings and grpc errors: "KVCache miss: eviction-threshold-exceeded". no config changes deployed in the last 2 hours.
alex: running some probes: `kubectl -n prod-us-east-az1 get pods -l app=inference -o wide`
alex: result: 3/8 pods Ready, several CrashLoopBackOff -> CgroupOOMKilled on node us-east-az1-n3.
leo: node metrics show memory pressure + GPU OOM on that node. autoscaler attempted to add nodes but hit reserved capacity ceiling for Dedicated pool.
priya: customer impact: elevated errors for hosted customers pinned to us-east-az1; global requests failover works but latency higher for some. opening incident page and pinging accounts team.
alex: standing up immediate mitigation: reduce batching and disable KV-cache warmup on az1 to lower memory footprint. also initiating routing fallback to shift traffic off az1.
alex: command to control plane: 
```
curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/v1/route-shift 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"from":"us-east-az1","to":["us-east-az2","us-east-az3"],"strategy":"weighted","weights":[0.5,0.5],"degraded_mode":true}'
```
incident-bot: route-shift request accepted; change-id=rs-2026-0901. Applying gradually.
incident-bot: traffic shift: 25% -> us-east-az2, 25% -> us-east-az3, 50% still to az1 (T+10s). Monitoring errors and latency.
jamie: after routing changes, 5xxs in az1 stayed high but overall user-facing errors dropped ~60% within 45s. p95 global latency increased ~80ms.
alex: spinning up replacement nodes in az1 backup pool and marking problematic node for cordon/drain: `kubectl cordon us-east-az1-n3 && kubectl drain ...`
leo: cordon/drain done. new nodes coming up but will take ~3-4m to reach steady state.
priya: customers affected list: 4 high-usage orgs with traffic affinity to az1. I'm pinging account leads and support to offer failover guidance.
alex: posting quick runbook notes in incident doc: https://wiki.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-2026-0901 (created).
samantha: i'm taking on-call handoff in 25m. will monitor the routing change and node replacements. alex, please DM any open action items you want me to own.
alex: handoff notes: 1) monitor PD alerts for az1 OOMs; 2) confirm k8s nodes reach Ready and pods stabilize; 3) if az1 errors persist >15m, promote full traffic evacuation off az1.
incident-bot: escalation timer paused (ack by alex). next escalation to priya canceled.
PagerDuty: Incident PD-53821 acknowledged by alex at 1901234568; escalation suspended.
priya: let's run a quick post-mortem checklist after stabilizing: root cause hypothesis = reserved capacity limits + cascade KVCACHE eviction under memory pressure. will collect heapdumps and kvcache diagnostics.
jamie: capturing logs and attaching to incident doc. also enabling temporary increased observability retention for this incident.
alex: marking this thread resolved for active paging — monitoring continues. will update incident doc with timeline and mitigation steps.
samantha: noted. i'll keep watch and update status every 10m until pods healthy.
incident-bot: thread status: mitigation_in_progress.
PagerDuty: PD-53821 | current status: acknowledged -> monitoring.
